results.title: Alban Bagbin, Prof Jane Naana to grace 2026 Women’s Democracy Cup
results.description: Prominent government personalities will grace the 2026 Women’s Democracy Cup between Ghana Army and Ghana Police on August 28, 2026.

results.title: Coshocton County genealogical society to hold Aug. 18 meeting at EMS building
results.description: The Coshocton County Chapter of the Ohio Genealogical Society will meet Aug. 18 at the new Coshocton County EMS building on Walnut Street. Speaker Margaret Lowe will be featured, and members, guests and new members are welcome.
